categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Titan Scientific Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the scientific research and technical services industry, providing one-stop laboratory products and supporting services for researchers and quality control personnel. Its main product lines include scientific research reagents, specialty chemicals, scientific instruments and consumables, and laboratory construction and scientific research informatization services. The company also engages in OEM production and sales of third-party branded products, forming a comprehensive product matrix.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary technologies such as flow chemistry, metal ion removal, parallel reaction technology, asymmetric synthesis, chiral analysis, and high-purity preparation techniques. It integrates advanced manufacturing methods including OEM production, intelligent warehousing and logistics, and digital platforms like the 'Exploration Platform' for sales and supply chain management. Continuous R&D investment supports development of new reagents, specialty chemicals, instruments, and software, with a focus on green, efficient, and automated synthesis processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include universities, hospitals, research institutes, government agencies, and innovative R&D enterprises across sectors such as biomedicine, new materials, new energy, environmental protection, food and daily chemicals, analytical testing, and intelligent manufacturing. The company serves over 60,000 customers and more than 1 million researchers, including over 150 Fortune 500 companies and comprehensive coverage of major Chinese academic and research institutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily concentrated in China, with a strong presence in the Yangtze River Delta region accounting for over 70% of revenue. It is expanding into other domestic regions including North China, Southwest, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Northeast. The company is also actively developing overseas channels to establish a foundation for its proprietary brands in international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Titan operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the scientific service supply chain. It develops and sells proprietary products, procures third-party branded products, and provides integrated services including logistics and laboratory construction. The company relies on OEM manufacturers for production of most proprietary reagents and specialty chemicals, while maintaining some in-house small-batch production capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company pursues a dual-core strategy focusing on independent innovation and industry infrastructure construction. R&D priorities include developing high-end reagents, specialty chemicals, instruments, and scientific software, with emphasis on green chemistry, automation, and digitalization. It invests heavily in intelligent synthesis platforms, microchannel reaction technology, and high-throughput screening. Strategic acquisitions enrich product lines and enhance manufacturing capabilities. The company also focuses on expanding its digital sales platform and optimizing supply chain efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of proprietary and third-party branded scientific reagents, specialty chemicals, instruments, consumables, and laboratory construction and informatization services. The company employs a direct sales model complemented by distribution channels. It also generates income from OEM production services and provides value-added services through its digital platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include global scientific service giants such as Thermo Fisher Scientific, Merck KGaA, Danaher, and domestic players like Sinopharm Reagent and Aladdin. Shanghai Titan positions itself as a leading domestic comprehensive scientific service provider with strong proprietary brands and integrated service capabilities. It competes on product innovation, brand recognition, service quality, and supply chain efficiency, aiming to increase market share through strategic acquisitions and platform development.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.88 billion, representing a 4.11% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 12.89 million, declining 82.23% due to pricing strategies and increased expenses amid intensified competition. Total assets grew 10.49% to RMB 4.85 billion. R&D investment remained stable at about 5.47% of revenue. The company maintains a strong cash flow position and continues to invest in capacity expansion and acquisitions to support long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Titan emphasizes a comprehensive one-stop scientific service platform combining proprietary high-quality reagents, specialty chemicals, instruments, and laboratory solutions with third-party products. Its competitive advantages include advanced core technologies, extensive product SKU offerings exceeding 7 million, strong brand portfolio, integrated digital sales and logistics platforms, and tailored customer service. The company focuses on innovation, green chemistry, and operational efficiency to deliver superior product quality, reliable supply, and enhanced customer experience, supporting domestic scientific research and industrial upgrading.
